title: Zebra holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <path d='M50 34 C46 26, 36 26, 36 34 C36 42, 50 50, 50 50 C50 50, 64 42, 64 34 C64 26, 54 26, 50 34Z' fill='#FF4D6D' stroke='#FF9DB3' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#F0F0F0'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='22' ry='18' fill='none'/>

  <path d='M32 72 Q40 68 48 72 Q56 76 66 72' fill='none' stroke='#4A4A6A' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M34 80 Q42 76 50 80 Q58 84 68 80' fill='none' stroke='#4A4A6A' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <path d='M66 60 Q72 54 68 48' fill='none' stroke='#E0E0E0' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <circle cx='38' cy='46' r='4' fill='#4A4A6A'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='46' r='4' fill='#4A4A6A'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='36' y='86' width='6' height='12' rx='2' fill='#E0E0E0'/>
  <rect x='58' y='86' width='6' height='12' rx='2' fill='#E0E0E0'/>
  <rect x='36' y='86' width='6' height='6' rx='2' fill='#4A4A6A'/>
  <rect x='58' y='86' width='6' height='6' rx='2' fill='#4A4A6A'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#F0F0F0'/>
  <!-- Head stripe -->
  <path d='M50 28 Q50 34 50 40' fill='none' stroke='#4A4A6A' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='30' rx='4' ry='7' fill='#F0F0F0' transform='rotate(-20 40 30)'/>

  <ellipse cx='40' cy='30' rx='2' ry='4' fill='#FFB3C1' transform='rotate(-20 40 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='30' rx='2' ry='4' fill='#FFB3C1' transform='rotate(20 60 30)'/>
  <!-- Mane -->
  <path d='M44 29 Q42 24 44 20' fill='none' stroke='#4A4A6A' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M48 28 Q48 22 50 18' fill='none' stroke='#4A4A6A' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 28 Q54 22 56 18' fill='none' stroke='#4A4A6A' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='38' r='3' fill='#3A3A5A'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='38' r='3' fill='#3A3A5A'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='37' r='1' fill='#AAD4FF'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='37' r='1' fill='#AAD4FF'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#FFD6DE'/>

  <path d='M47 48 Q50 50 53 48' fill='none' stroke='#4A4A6A' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
